profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Everyday Health Group
profile.summary:
Driven by curiosity and creativity, I'm always trying to understand the Why and How of everything around me. 

My interest in software was intensified in my college years, thanks to some classes of Python and Matlab. With that knowledge, I gained a new toolkit that improved my learning process and allowed me to explore my creativity.

I've been working in the last 6 years as a Software Engineer contributing at all levels of the web application stack taking part in the full spectrum of the development life cycle using JavaScript and Python ecosystems.

SKILLS:

• Typescript 
• SQL DB
• NoSQL DB
• Node.js
• AWS

positions.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
positions.description:
• Build Quarteria's real estate marketplace application that boosted an acquisition deal
• Developed a Neo Blockchain Smart contracts using Python that served the ICO and marketplace application for 1000+ users
• Developed a Node.js service implementing IPFS and Neo Wallets to return data in JSON format to the client side from the smart contract
• Designed and developed the real estate marketplace user interface using Handlebars.js that facilitated the registration of 100+ properties

positions.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
positions.description:
• Delivered the music social network application, executing front-end and back-end development to support over 5,000 users and 30,000 songs
• Developed the API using Laravel and Symfony
• Leverage AngularJS to develop new features and improvements to the existing user interface
• Documented the standardized development environment set up and workflow procedures optimizing the on-boarding process of new developers
